methodology:
Audit: for every node where CF-GNNExplainer actually removed edges and the
LLM generated a narration, does the narration's text accurately describe
those removed edges?

Heuristic (applied uniformly, documented so it can be re-checked by hand):
  - "mentions a removed edge" = the raw LLM output contains the global node
    ID of at least one endpoint involved in a removed edge, within a window
    of text that also contains removal-indicating language (removed, no
    longer, disconnect, lost/severed connection, eliminat*).
  - "contradiction" = the text uses edge-ADDITION language ("new edge",
    "introduced a[n] ... edge/connection", "added a connection", "new
    connection") anywhere -- CF-GNNExplainer here only ever deletes edges
    (P in [0,1] multiplies the existing adjacency, never exceeds it), so any
    addition claim is a factual inversion by construction, not a borderline
    case.
